final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. A caveated business characterization is more precise than an overbroad clean-compliance claim, but reinterpretation and better framing do not close the original compliance gap. That is why this remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats: the caveat describes an unresolved compliance condition instead of curing it.
